title: Four hands
checked: Every reachable state checked (10 states, 9 steps). All three rules hold.

rules.says: A coding agent can pick up planned work, but approving a request is triage, and triage is human (WorkItem::AGENT_TRANSITIONS).
rules.path: Let the agent approve its own item and it breaks in 2 steps: request_feature, agent approves its own item.

rules.rule: Nothing ships without a pull request
rules.says: In review needs a GitHub pull request URL, and you merge only what is in review.
rules.path: Take away the guard on "merge and ship" and it breaks in 6 steps: request_feature, approve as planned, list_work_items, item 7 is planned, update to in_progress, merge and ship, with no PR attached.

rules.rule: One order, and it always finishes
rules.says: From any point there is only one next message, and every run ends shipped, with the asker told.
rules.path: Holds on every path: nine messages, top to bottom.
